nodes.label: Group Code Icon
nodes.description: An SVG icon depicting three overlapping user/person silhouettes arranged in a group formation. The center figure sits slightly elevated and overlaps the two flanking figures. Each silhouette consists of a circular head and a rounded-bottom torso/body shape, all rendered in white fill with black strokes. The composition conveys a concept of a group, team, or community. Additionally, three small clusters of dots (each cluster containing 4 dots arranged in an L or square pattern) appear at three corners of the composition — upper-right, lower-left, and upper-left near the center figure. These dot clusters suggest a 'code' or 'keypad' metaphor, reinforcing the 'group code' naming. The overall icon is likely used to represent a group invitation code, referral group, team code, or community access feature.
